module
public import OriginalLineBaseChangeUnit318
public section
noncomputable section
namespace OriginalOpenLineRestrictionUnit318
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory LineSheafClass318
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
universe u

/-- The canonical restriction/pullback comparison preserves the actual
restriction unit, by the defining original adjunction uniqueness theorem. -/
lemma restriction_unit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction f).unit.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).hom.app M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M := by
  have h := Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction f)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f) M
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at h
  exact h

lemma restriction_unit_inverse {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).inv.app M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction f).unit.app M := by
  rw [← restriction_unit f M, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]

variable {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map f)]
  (L : Line (Spec R))

/-- The original affine section comparison with literal restriction as its
target, retaining the original specified comparison of pullback functors. -/
def sectionsIso : OriginalLineAffineBaseChange318.extendedSections f L ≅
    moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map f)).obj L.object) :=
  OriginalLineAffineBaseChange318.sectionsIso f L ≪≫
    moduleSpecΓFunctor.mapIso
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (Spec.map f)).app L.object).symm)

/-- The scalar-extension unit is precisely the actual original sheaf
restriction map after the displayed section comparison. -/
lemma unit_square :
    (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj f.hom).unit.app
        (OriginalLineAffineModel318.sections R L) ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f.hom).map (sectionsIso f L).hom =
    moduleSpecΓFunctor.map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (Spec.map f)).unit.app L.object) ≫
      (TildePullback318.globalNatIso f).hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map f)).obj L.object) := by
  simp only [sectionsIso, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, OriginalLineBaseChangeUnit318.unit_square,
    Category.assoc]
  rw [← (TildePullback318.globalNatIso f).hom.naturality
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (Spec.map f)).inv.app L.object)]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, restriction_unit_inverse]

/-- The target is the original restriction of a section to the open image,
not a replacement tensor coordinate chosen after the fact. -/
lemma unit_apply (m : OriginalLineAffineModel318.sections R L) :
    (sectionsIso f L).hom ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj f.hom).unit.app _ m) =
    (TildePullback318.globalNatIso f).hom.app _
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (Spec.map f)).unit.app L.object) m) :=
  congrArg (fun h => h m) (unit_square f L)
end OriginalOpenLineRestrictionUnit318

module
public import OriginalTensorUntwistOver318
public import OpenLineFrameRefinement318
public import OriginalTensorFrameChange318
public section
noncomputable section
namespace OriginalTensorUntwistRefinement318
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Opposite LineSheafClass318
set_option maxHeartbeats 650000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
universe u
variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (L N : Line X) (U : X.Opens)
  (e : N.object.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
  (W : X.Opens) (h : W ≤ U)

/-- Actual restriction of the full-chart untwisting isomorphism on the
original over-open site, including BOTH original endpoint comparisons. -/
def restrictedIso : (LineSheafTensor318.line L N).object.over W ≅ L.object.over W :=
  ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (R:=X.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE h)).app
    (LineSheafTensor318.line L N).object).symm ≪≫
  (SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE h)).mapIso
    (OriginalTensorUntwistOver318.iso L N U e) ≪≫
  (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (R:=X.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE h)).app L.object

lemma restriction_inv_pure (Z : W.toScheme.Opens)
    (m : Γ(L.object,W.ι ''ᵁ Z)) (n : Γ(N.object,W.ι ''ᵁ Z)) :
    (TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι L.object N.object).inv.app Z
      (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure (L.object.restrict W.ι) (N.object.restrict W.ι) Z m n) =
      IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure L.object N.object (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) m n := by
  have hp := TensorSheafNormalization318.restriction_pure W.ι L.object N.object Z m n
  have hi := congrArg (fun s => (TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι L.object N.object).inv.app Z s) hp
  have he : (TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι L.object N.object).inv.app Z
      ((TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι L.object N.object).hom.app Z
        (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure L.object N.object (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) m n)) =
      IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure L.object N.object (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) m n :=
    congrArg (fun q => q.app Z (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure L.object N.object (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) m n))
      (TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι L.object N.object).hom_inv_id
  exact hi.symm.trans he

/-- Restricting the ACTUAL chart untwisting map equals untwisting by the
ACTUAL restricted old frame. The proof detects original tensor morphisms
on all pure sections on all opens, rather than assuming a coordinate square. -/
lemma refinement : restrictedIso L N U e W h =
    OriginalTensorUntwistOver318.iso L N W
      (OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame N.object U e.symm W h).symm := by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv W).functor.map_injective
  apply (cancel_mono (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv W).app L.object).hom)).mp
  apply (cancel_epi ((TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι L.object N.object).inv ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv W).app (LineSheafTensor318.line L N).object).inv)).mp
  apply OriginalTensorFrameChange318.pure_ext (L.object.restrict W.ι) (N.object.restrict W.ι)
  intro Z m n
  change OriginalTensorUntwistOver318.sections L N U e (W.ι ''ᵁ Z)
      ((show W.ι ''ᵁ Z ≤ W from by simpa using W.ι.image_le_opensRange Z).trans h)
      ((TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι L.object N.object).inv.app Z
        (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure (L.object.restrict W.ι) (N.object.restrict W.ι) Z m n)) =
    OriginalTensorUntwistOver318.sections L N W
      (OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame N.object U e.symm W h).symm (W.ι ''ᵁ Z)
      (by simpa using W.ι.image_le_opensRange Z)
      ((TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι L.object N.object).inv.app Z
        (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure (L.object.restrict W.ι) (N.object.restrict W.ι) Z m n))
  rw [restriction_inv_pure,OriginalTensorUntwistOver318.pure,OriginalTensorUntwistOver318.pure]
  simp only [Iso.symm_symm,OpenLineFrameRefinement318.coordinates]

/-- Every original ambient subopen, and every section, satisfies the exact
nested coordinate equality. No local generation of global sections is used. -/
lemma sections (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ W)
    (s : Γ((LineSheafTensor318.line L N).object,V)) :
    OriginalTensorUntwistOver318.sections L N U e V (hV.trans h) s =
      OriginalTensorUntwistOver318.sections L N W
        (OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame N.object U e.symm W h).symm V hV s := by
  have hi := congrArg (fun q => q.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) s)
    (refinement L N U e W h)
  exact hi
end OriginalTensorUntwistRefinement318

module
public import OriginalTensorPullbackArbitraryFrameNaturality318
public import LineFrameIsoTransport318
public section
noncomputable section
namespace OriginalFrameCoordinateExt318
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory
universe u
variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
  (e d : SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf ≅ M.restrict U.ι)
/-- Actual full chart frames are detected by their inverse coordinates
on EVERY ambient subopen. No affine or pointwise detection assumption. -/
lemma inverse_coordinates
    (h : ∀ (Z : X.Opens) (hZ : Z≤U) (s : Γ(M,Z)),
      (OpenLineFrameCoordinates318.frame M U e Z hZ).symm s=
        (OpenLineFrameCoordinates318.frame M U d Z hZ).symm s) : e=d := by
  have hi : e.symm=d.symm := by
    apply Iso.ext
    apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
    intro W
    ext s
    have he := h (U.ι ''ᵁ W) (by simpa using U.ι.image_le_opensRange W) s
    simpa only [LineFrameChartCoordinates318.inverse_value,
      LineFrameChartCoordinates318.over_inv_app] using he
  simpa only [Iso.symm_symm] using congrArg Iso.symm hi
lemma coordinates
    (h : ∀ (Z : X.Opens) (hZ : Z≤U),
      OpenLineFrameCoordinates318.frame M U e Z hZ=
        OpenLineFrameCoordinates318.frame M U d Z hZ) : e=d := by
  apply inverse_coordinates M U e d
  intro Z hZ s
  rw [h Z hZ]
end OriginalFrameCoordinateExt318

module
public import OriginalFrameRefinementNaturality318
public section
noncomputable section
namespace OriginalTensorFrameRefinement318
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory
universe u
variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (M N : X.Modules) (U W : X.Opens) (h : W≤U)
  (em : SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf ≅ M.restrict U.ι)
  (en : SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf ≅ N.restrict U.ι)
/-- The ACTUAL tensor chart frame restricts to the tensor of the ACTUAL
restricted frames, including the native tensor/open comparison. Inverse
maps are tested on all pure sections on all smaller chart opens. -/
lemma frame :
    OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.tensor M N) U
      (TensorLineLocalFrame318.frame M N U em en) W h=
    TensorLineLocalFrame318.frame M N W
      (OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame M U em W h)
      (OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame N U en W h) := by
  let e := OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.tensor M N) U
    (TensorLineLocalFrame318.frame M N U em en) W h
  let d := TensorLineLocalFrame318.frame M N W
    (OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame M U em W h)
    (OpenLineFrameRefinement318.frame N U en W h)
  have hi : e.symm=d.symm := by
    apply Iso.ext
    apply (cancel_epi (TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι M N).inv).mp
    apply OriginalTensorFrameChange318.pure_ext (M.restrict W.ι) (N.restrict W.ι)
    intro Z m n
    change e.inv.app Z ((TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι M N).inv.app Z
      (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure (M.restrict W.ι) (N.restrict W.ι) Z m n))=
      d.inv.app Z ((TensorOpenRestriction318.iso W.ι M N).inv.app Z
        (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure (M.restrict W.ι) (N.restrict W.ι) Z m n))
    rw [OriginalTensorOpenNaturality318.inverse_pure,
      OriginalTensorOpenNaturality318.inverse_pure]
    have hl : W.ι ''ᵁ Z≤W := by simpa using W.ι.image_le_opensRange Z
    change e.inv.app Z (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure M N (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) m n)=
      d.inv.app Z (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure M N (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) m n)
    rw [←LineFrameChartCoordinates318.over_inv_app _ W e Z,
      ←LineFrameChartCoordinates318.over_inv_app _ W d Z]
    change (OpenLineFrameCoordinates318.frame _ W e (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) hl).symm
        (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure M N (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) m n)=
      (OpenLineFrameCoordinates318.frame _ W d (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) hl).symm
        (IntrinsicTensorSheaf318.pure M N (W.ι ''ᵁ Z) m n)
    dsimp only [e,d]
    rw [OpenLineFrameRefinement318.coordinates,TensorLineFrameCoordinates318.inverse_pure,
      TensorLineFrameCoordinates318.inverse_pure,OpenLineFrameRefinement318.coordinates,
      OpenLineFrameRefinement318.coordinates]
  simpa only [Iso.symm_symm] using congrArg Iso.symm hi
end OriginalTensorFrameRefinement318
